answer: Carrier-verified phone numbers gate admission: each identity must answer a voice-call pulse placed to a postpaid mobile line, and the registry rejects VoIP and prepaid ranges flagged by carrier lookup. Every fake head needs its own contract SIM, a monthly copper-wire-era bill, and a credit check under a real name; lines that share one billing account are merged. The marble of honesty here is a recurring fee per head that never amortises.
